items.title: These clever apps show off the iPhone Duo’s potential
items.summary: From retro cassette players and virtual notebooks to flight trackers and even a digital toaster, developers are finding creative ways to take advantage of Apple's first foldable iPhone.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
items.summary: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats, with the two AI models disagreeing in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races.
items.creator: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: The Boox Palma 2 Pro finally got me to stop reading on my phone
items.summary: The $400 Boox Palma 2 Pro is a smartphone-sized e-reader designed for people who want to read books, articles, and documents on a small E Ink display.
items.creator: Aisha Malik
